questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “Staff first verified the original receipts.”, what does “verify” mean?
questions.answer: check that something is accurate or true
options: check that something is accurate or true
questions.explanation: Here, “verify” means to check that something is accurate or true.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The department will implement the revised procedure in July.”, what does “implement” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “implement” means to put into effect.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The office streamlined the application process.”, what does “streamline” mean?
questions.answer: simplify a process to improve efficiency
options: simplify a process to improve efficiency
questions.explanation: Here, “streamline” means to simplify a process to improve efficiency.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The offices consolidated their separate registers.”, what does “consolidate” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “consolidate” means to bring separate parts together.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “Applicants must disclose relevant conflicts.”, what does “disclose” mean?
options: correct a figure without announcing it
questions.explanation: Here, “disclose” means to make information known.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The group assessed the feasibility of the plan.”, what does “assess” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “assess” means to evaluate.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The unit procured equipment for its new office.”, what does “procure” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “procure” means to obtain through a purchasing process.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The agency decided to renew its agreement for a further year.”, what does “renew” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “renew” means to extend for another period.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The office had to curtail nonessential travel.”, what does “curtail” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “curtail” means to reduce or limit.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The council allocated funds to improve access.”, what does “allocate” mean?
options: transfer an obligation out of a treaty
questions.explanation: Here, “allocate” means to assign resources to a use.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The agency benchmarked its turnaround time.”, what does “benchmark” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “benchmark” means to compare with a reference standard.

questions.subject: en
questions.question: In “The report supplied records to substantiate its finding.”, what does “substantiate” mean?
questions.explanation: Here, “substantiate” means to support a claim with evidence.
